outputs.explanation: Panel A contains a bar chart of cell death (%) reported as mean ± s.d. of three independent experiments, with no individual data points overlaid on the bars (only error bars are shown). The panel also contains western blot images, but the bar chart requires individual points.

Panel B contains a bar chart of cell death (%) shown with error bars only; the caption does not indicate replicate points are shown and none are visible on the bars. Western blot images accompany the plot but do not affect this assessment.
Panel C is a grouped bar chart of cell death (%) across time points, reported as mean ± s.d. of three experiments, without individual data points overlaid on the bars.
Panel D contains a bar chart of cell death (%) with error bars only and no overlaid individual data points; it also includes western blot images which are not plots.
